description: CancelKits Cloudflare Cache Rules configuration to push edge cache hit rates > 70%

rules.description: Bypass Edge Cache for authenticated areas, API routes, and OAuth sessions
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/api/*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/dashboard*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/account*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/signin*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/signup*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/auth/*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/onboarding*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/r/*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/start*") or (http.cookie contains "sb-access-token")

rules.description: Aggressively cache hashed static JS/CSS/Fonts/Images at Cloudflare Edge (1 Year TTL)
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/_astro/*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/og/*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "*.woff2") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "*.svg") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "*.png") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "*.ico")

rules.description: Cache all 200 OK cancel guides, blog posts, calculators, and marketing pages at Cloudflare Edge (7 Days TTL, Stale-While-Revalidate)
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/cancel/*") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/cancel/") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/blog/*") or (http.request.uri.path eq "/blog/") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/pricing*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/about*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/security*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/alternatives*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/wall-of-love*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/privacy*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/terms*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/cookies*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/calculator*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/cancel-difficulty*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/gym-cancellation-letter*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/subscription-creep-calculator*") or (http.request.uri.path wildcard "/statement-scanner*")
